req.title: Return 405 for unsupported /players root method
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 when using DELETE on /players/ (collection).

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-036 requires HTTP 405 when DELETE is issued against the /players/ collection endpoint. The router only registers POST and GET on /players/; DELETE is only registered on /players/squadnumber/{squad_number}. FastAPI/Starlette returns 405 Method Not Allowed when a route path matches but the HTTP method is not registered. Tests cover: (1) positive — DELETE /players/ returns exactly 405, (2) negative — GET /players/ returns 200 (valid method, same path, proving the path itself is reachable), (3) boundary — POST /players/ returns 201/422 (not 405), confirming method discrimination is per-verb, (4) decision-table — DELETE on the specific sub-resource /players/squadnumber/1 returns 204 (not 405), proving DELETE is only blocked at the collection root, (5) negative-path — HEAD and PATCH on /players/ also return 405, confirming the constraint is method-level.

tests.name: test_delete_players_collection_returns_405
preconditions: DELETE method is not registered on /players/ collection route
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 405
trace: R-PLAYER-036: system shall respond with HTTP 405 when using DELETE on /players/ (collection)
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_delete_players_collection_returns_405():
    r = client.delete('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 405

test_delete_players_collection_returns_405()

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_get_players_collection_returns_200_not_405():
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.status_code != 405
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) > 0

tests.name: test_delete_players_collection_response_body_and_headers
preconditions: DELETE method is not registered on /players/ collection route
actions: Inspect response status code and content-type header
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 405
Response body contains 'detail' or 'Method Not Allowed' information
trace: R-PLAYER-036: HTTP 405 response must be well-formed with correct status code
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_delete_players_collection_response_body_and_headers():
    r = client.delete('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 405
    ct = r.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    body = r.json()
    assert 'detail' in body
    assert body['detail'] == 'Method Not Allowed'

test_delete_players_collection_response_body_and_headers()

tests.name: test_post_players_collection_not_405

actions: Send POST request to /players/ with invalid body to trigger 422
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 422, not 405
POST is an allowed method on /players/ collection
trace: R-PLAYER-036: only DELETE is blocked at /players/; POST must not return 405
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_players_collection_not_405():
    r = client.post('/players/', json={})
    assert r.status_code == 422
    assert r.status_code != 405

test_post_players_collection_not_405()
